name: Non-Wilderness skeletons
accessNote: Non-Wilderness skeletons for Turael, Spria, and Mazchna tasks: the Edgeville Dungeon, Varrock Sewers, and Draynor/Wizards' Tower basements hold level 21/22 skeletons. The Slayer task/Skeletons table (pageid 298266) lists both Edgeville Dungeon and Varrock Sewers as cannonable.
